quote: Peskine and Szpiro announced their groundbreaking results in 1969... Hochster formulated the Direct Summand Conjecture around 1969
note: The conjectures were formulated and announced in 1969. Peskine and Szpiro's full publication came in 1973 in Publications Mathématiques de l'IHÉS. Hochster's comprehensive treatment appeared in his 1975 CBMS monograph.
